title: Streaming port mappings reverse the public host-to-container mapping
reasoning: The exec runtime interprets ports as host_port to container_port, but streaming passes the same dictionary directly to Docker SDK containers.create, whose keys identify container ports and values identify host bindings. Consequently, {8080: 80} publishes container port 8080 on host port 80 instead of container port 80 on host port 8080.
reproduction: Create a bridge-network streaming runtime with ports={8080: 80} and run a service on container port 80. The expected host endpoint on port 8080 is not published.
recommendation: Translate the public host-to-container mapping into Docker SDK container-to-host bindings before creating the container.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The streaming test only checks the stored dictionary; it never checks SDK arguments or connectivity with unequal ports.
suggestedRegressionTest: Extend port scenarios to verify SDK bindings and host connectivity for unequal host and container ports, while retaining host-network behavior.
minimumFixScope: Streaming port conversion and port mapping tests.
